title: Samsung's Q2 Profits Jump Amid Chip Shortage and AI Demand
description: Samsung Electronics reported a significant increase in profits in Q2 2026, largely due to demand for AI chips, according to their official announcement. The company also anticipates the global chip shortage to extend to 2028, as reported by Reuters.

sources.title: Samsung sees chip shortage extending to 2028, touts long-term supply deals

sections.heading: Financial Performance
paragraphs: Samsung Electronics announced its financial results for the second quarter of 2026, highlighting a substantial increase in profits. This growth is attributed to the rising demand for AI chips, which has offset losses in the mobile sector.

sections.heading: Chip Shortage and Future Projections
paragraphs: Reuters reports that Samsung foresees the ongoing global chip shortage to last until 2028. The company is emphasizing the importance of long-term supply deals in response to this situation.

sections.heading: AI Gold Rush and Cash Flow
paragraphs: Nikkei Asia notes that memory makers, including Samsung, are experiencing a significant cash flow of $90 billion due to the AI gold rush, indicating a strong market for semiconductors in the context of artificial intelligence applications.

faq.q: What was the reason for Samsung's profit increase in Q2 2026?
faq.a: Samsung's profit increase in Q2 2026 was largely due to the rising demand for AI chips, as stated in their official announcement.

faq.q: How long does Samsung predict the chip shortage to last?
faq.a: According to Reuters, Samsung predicts the global chip shortage to extend to 2028.

faq.q: What is the impact of AI on the semiconductor industry?
faq.a: Nikkei Asia reports that memory makers, including Samsung, are experiencing a significant cash flow of $90 billion due to the AI gold rush, highlighting the impact of AI on the semiconductor industry.
